scope: Primary-build supplements; newsletter indexing is selective, not a complete article catalog or service-bulletin compliance audit.
authority: Companion plans govern design. Current Companion count sheet governs explicit QB hardware. Named factory alerts are separate sources; conflicts remain open. Builder photographs and historical articles do not supply critical specifications.

references.source: 2017_Beartracks.pdf, PDF p14 / Q2 p6, Mark Richardson: Locating the Fuel Tank Filler Hole
references.summary: Transfer the actual fitted filler-neck center to a paper template; fit the actual tank before marking. Historical hole sizes and cutting methods are not Companion instructions. Tank-bay bottom drain openings are a different operation.

references.source: 2018_Beartracks.pdf, PDF pp19-21 / Q3 pp3-5, Kevin Deutscher: Rigging a Bearhawk, Part 1
references.summary: Check free movement at each connection stage, hose/spring clearance, hinge alignment and independent final control-direction/security checks. Numerical incidence, shim fabrication and balance changes are not adopted.

references.source: 2018_Beartracks.pdf, PDF p4 / Q1 p4, Tail Post Reinforcement
references.summary: Round-spring tailpost reinforcement history; does not establish a Companion stinger installation or authorize welding the current kit.

references.source: 2019_Beartracks.pdf, PDF p2 / Q1 p2, Safety Update from Bob
references.summary: Historical trim cable tension notice predates the Companion. Obtain current Companion tension and measurement conditions.

references.source: 2019_Beartracks.pdf, PDF pp6-7 / Q1 pp6-7, Jared Yates: A Tale of Two Tail Struts
references.summary: Welded threaded-end corrosion/fatigue history and a builder repair. Do not copy the replacement clevis, weld, material or strut length to the Companion.

references.source: 2020_Beartracks.pdf, PDF p18 / Q2 p10, Collin Campbell tips
references.model: Model not established in this item
references.summary: A contrasting striped backing improves sight-tube readability. No fuel-level calibration is supplied; clip-nut clamp substitutions are not adopted.

references.source: 2020_Beartracks.pdf, PDF p24 / Q3 p4, Fuel System Discussion About Pumps
references.model: General notice plus Patrol builder example
references.summary: Pump-fed systems require a configuration-specific assessment; a builder flight anecdote does not validate a Companion installation. No header tank or plumbing modification is added.

references.source: 2021_Beartracks.pdf, PDF p9 / Q2 p1, Updates from Bob Barrows: April flap hinge correction
references.summary: Check the corrected inboard flap hinge drawing against the supplied hinge before drilling. Newsletter sketch is a design reference, not a scaled template.

references.source: 2021_Beartracks.pdf, PDF p27 / Q3 p11, Flap Pulley Mount Reinforcement
references.summary: Station F reinforcement responds to a Patrol weld failure. It is a different matter from factory AD-004 aft pulley wear; no Companion reinforcement is inferred.

references.source: 2021_Beartracks.pdf, PDF p35 / Q4 p7, Five Flap Cable Routing
references.summary: The notice states that the Five uses the opposite side from the 4-Place. Five photographs cannot settle an uncertain Companion pulley side.

references.source: 2021_Beartracks.pdf, PDF p9 / Q2 p1, Dave Lenart first Companion
references.summary: Exterior and seat appearance are recognizable Companion references. Upholstery and performance figures are not build geometry.

references.source: 2022_Beartracks.pdf, PDF pp6-7 / Q1 pp6-7, Bruce Case: Aileron and Flap Hinges
references.model: Bearhawk model not explicitly established in article
references.summary: Paired airfoil templates hold the surface in position; hinge axes must align and bolt insertion access must remain. Exact offsets, jig dimensions and hardware are not transferred.

references.source: 2022_Beartracks.pdf, PDF p9 / Q1 p9, New Brake Master Cylinders Designed by Bob
references.summary: The introduction describes machined cylinders and longer forks. This is not an endorsement to install affected cylinders after factory AD-002.

references.source: 2022_Beartracks.pdf, PDF p16 / Q2 p4, Mark Goldberg: Elevator Trim Torque Tube on Factory Kits
references.model: Factory kits; exact delivered joint to be checked
references.decision: Inspection view and review item added
references.summary: Inspect the bolted outboard arm-to-tube joint for play and preserve access. Factory commentary recommends clean mating surfaces and red Loctite; exact product and current-kit application need confirmation.

references.source: 2022_Beartracks.pdf, PDF pp14-16 / Q2 pp2-4, Mark Scott: Inboard Flap Extension
references.summary: Do not adopt flap extensions, reflex settings or modified operating limits as standard Companion configuration.

references.source: 2022_Beartracks.pdf, PDF p29 / Q3 p9, Mark Johnson: Pocket Rib Drilling
references.summary: Tool-access technique; no Companion drilling coordinates or fastener specification derived.

references.source: 2022_Beartracks.pdf, PDF p41 / Q4 p9, Maximum Flap Speeds
references.summary: Supplied newsletter first-setting limit differs from currently hosted factory OA-002. Do not use this page alone for placarding.

references.source: 2023_Beartracks.pdf, PDF p9 / Q1 p9, March clarification of December notice
references.summary: Deflections are in flight under air loads; ground deflection is greater. Newsletter first setting is 100 mph; current factory OA-002 says 95 mph. Obtain an applicable current determination.

references.source: 2023_Beartracks.pdf, PDF p9 / Q1 p9, Landing Gear Tread Width Adjustments
references.summary: Companion spread limits corroborate current factory OA-001, which adds the straight-roll measurement condition. Illustrated measurement uses the current factory condition.

references.source: 2023_Beartracks.pdf, PDF p28 / Q3 p8, Dual-Brake Safety Update
references.decision: Historical mitigation replaced by current alert
references.summary: Newsletter described trapped brake pressure and temporary options. Current factory AD-002 adds seal-wear concerns and directs affected-cylinder replacement; do not treat single-pilot use as exempt.

references.source: 2024_Beartracks.pdf, PDF p2 / Q1 p2, Bob Barrows Begins a Companion Build
references.summary: Kit-build progress and installed gear context. No dimensions or supplied hardware identities derived.

references.source: 2024_Beartracks.pdf, PDF p36 / Q4 p4, Jay Townsend walk-around
references.summary: Tail-cone oblique view and underside gear/shock views. Black cargo tube, vents and vortex generators are builder choices, not adopted standard features.

references.source: 2025_Beartracks.pdf, PDF p23 / Q2 p13, Bob Barrows signed Engineering Note, May 29 2025
references.summary: Optional heavier gear-leg/axle materials for heavy-duty use. Do not assume supplied gear needs replacement; no material substitution is introduced.

references.source: 2025_Beartracks.pdf, PDF pp42-43 / Q4 pp8-9, George Huntington construction tips
references.model: Builder example; model not specified in item
references.summary: Tube templates, bend tooling, strut drilling support and inspection-cover jigs. Final dimensions and material/fastener decisions still require controlling Companion documents.

references.source: Patrol-2004-2009.pdf, PDF p19 left / January 2005 p2, Drawing Omission
references.summary: Historical aileron cable-pulley relationship at wing strut. Applicability is limited by model and plans serial number; no offset transferred.

references.source: Patrol-2004-2009.pdf, PDF p59 / 2009 p5, Tail Spring - Patrol
references.summary: Rod-spring drawing does not establish Companion rear socket, retention stack or supplied tailwheel configuration.

references.source: Patrol-2004-2009.pdf, PDF p61 / 2009 p7, Tail Wire Ends and Trim Pushrod
references.summary: Homemade terminals and a bent trim rod are not substitutes for the current Companion terminal inventory or plan22 linkage geometry.

references.source: Factory AD-002, 4/1/2025, Brake Master Cylinders, pp1-4
references.model: All; Companion named for Matco restrictor
references.summary: Identify affected Avipro/Barrows cylinders and follow factory replacement direction. Gerdes excluded. Companion Matco replacement requires travel restrictors; exact installation is in pp3-4.

references.source: Factory AD-004, 12/11/25, Flap System Pulley Failure, p1
references.model: Five, Four A, Four B, Companion
references.summary: Aft-most pulley: inspect annually / 250 hours; replace at 500 hours or as needed. Keep access and track service time. The alert names MS20220-1 (AN202A-1).

references.source: Factory OA-001, March 1 2023, Gear Spread Limits, p1
references.summary: Measure tire centers at their fronts, at appropriate static load, after rolling straight at least 25 ft. Companion: 72 in at flying weight, 74 in maximum static spread; recommended minimum rod-end engagement 5/8 in.

references.source: Factory OA-002, March 1 2023, Flap Extension Speed, p1
references.summary: Currently hosted alert lists 95 mph at 10 degrees in flight; supplied March 2023 newsletter lists 100 mph. Both separate air-loaded in-flight deflection from ground setting. No operational placard is issued here.

references.source: Factory AD-001, June 16 2020, Horizontal Attach Fitting, pp1-2
references.summary: Factory alert names LSA/Patrol forged stabilizer-strut fittings. It does not establish a Companion repair or replacement requirement.
